# AutoSmartCode

> A dealer gives AutoSmartCode their buying rules, and AutoSmartCode automatically searches, filters, researches and ranks vehicles across auctions and marketplaces — with Carfax, AutoCheck and MMR on the dealer's own accounts — so the dealer can focus on buying.

AutoSmartCode is a one-developer software studio, run by Sam, that works only
for the car trade. It builds and runs custom automation for independent
dealers, wholesalers, dealer groups and auction buyers in the US, UK, the
Gulf, Europe and Australia. The core job: read an entire auction run list
overnight (Manheim, ADESA, ACV, OPENLANE or a private dealer portal), apply
the dealer's own buy box, pull title, Carfax, AutoCheck and Manheim MMR per
VIN, write a note and a max bid per car, and leave the survivors in the
dealer's own watch list by 6 AM. It also builds Chrome and Edge extensions
that show MMR, history and margin on the listing page, daily alerts from
marketplaces and government and off-lease sales, and custom dealer software
that connects those accounts into one system. Everything runs on the
client's own licensed accounts; it does not resell data or build automated
bidding.

Key facts:

- Who it is for: used-car dealers, wholesalers, dealer groups and auction buyers. Not consumers, and not other industries.
- How it works: built per client and run on the client's own auction, Carfax, AutoCheck and Manheim accounts. No data resale, no shared credentials, no automated bidding.
- Pricing: VIN-Scan Extension, $50–$100/month — depending on the data sources shown; Overnight Auction Watch List, $500/month — per auction site · every sale, Mon–Fri; Marketplaces & Custom Software, Custom — fixed price, quoted in 24 hours; Try One Sale, $150 one-off — one sale, delivered in 48 hours.
- Timeline: most run-list triage builds are live in 3 to 7 days; extensions take 5 to 10.
- Maintenance: when an auction site changes and a job breaks, the client hears from an alert the same morning; fixes are covered by the monthly fee.
- Contact: the form at https://www.autosmartcode.com/#contact (email required, WhatsApp optional). Fixed-price quotes within 24 hours.

## Primary services

- [Auction Run-List Triage — Watch List Built Before You Reach the Office](https://www.autosmartcode.com/services/auction-run-list-triage): 5,000 cars in the sale cut to the few hundred worth bidding on, overnight. Your filters, Carfax, AutoCheck and MMR per VIN, notes written, watch list by 6 AM.
- [Custom Dealer Extension — MMR, Carfax & AutoCheck on the Car Page in Real Time](https://www.autosmartcode.com/services/dealer-browser-extension): An Autoniq alternative built to your workflow: MMR, Carfax, AutoCheck and your margin maths on the listing in real time. $50–$100 a month, no setup fee.
- [Daily Marketplace, Government & Lease Sale Monitoring for Car Dealers](https://www.autosmartcode.com/services/marketplace-government-lease-sales): OPENLANE, Facebook Marketplace, eBay Motors, GovDeals, GSA Auctions and off-lease sales checked daily for your buy box. New matches in your inbox each morning.
- [Vehicle History Report Automation — Carfax, AutoCheck and VIN Data](https://www.autosmartcode.com/services/vehicle-history-reports): Stop pulling history reports one VIN at a time. Bulk VIN decoding and automated Carfax or AutoCheck retrieval through your own dealer account, in one sheet.
- [Car Auction Automation for Dealers and Wholesalers](https://www.autosmartcode.com/services/car-auction-automation): Automated auction data for dealers and wholesalers. Run lists from Manheim, ADESA, ACV or the private portal you actually buy on, scored against MMR daily.
- [Custom Dealer Software — Manheim, Carfax, AutoCheck & Autoniq in One System](https://www.autosmartcode.com/services/custom-dealer-software): Custom software for car dealers and wholesalers that connects Manheim, MMR, Carfax, AutoCheck, Autoniq and your DMS into one dashboard built around how you buy.

## Wholesale auction platforms (run lists, condition reports, MMR scoring)

- [Manheim MMR Scraper](https://www.autosmartcode.com/manheim-mmr-scraper): Automate Manheim MMR lookups through your own dealer account. Bulk VIN valuations, run-list scoring and a ranked deal email before the lane opens.
- [ADESA Scraper](https://www.autosmartcode.com/adesa-scraper): Automate ADESA run lists, condition grades and sale calendars through your own dealer account. Every lot scored against MMR before the sale starts.
- [ACV Auctions Scraper](https://www.autosmartcode.com/acv-auctions-scraper): Automate ACV Auctions listings, condition reports and inspection data through your own dealer account. Lots scored against your buy box, overnight.
- [OpenLane Scraper](https://www.autosmartcode.com/openlane-scraper): Automate OPENLANE listings, condition reports and pricing through your own dealer account. Every lot scored against market value, ranked daily.
- [BacklotCars Scraper](https://www.autosmartcode.com/backlotcars-scraper): Automate BacklotCars inventory, buy-now pricing and offer data through your own account. Every listing scored against market value, ranked daily.
- [SmartAuction Scraper](https://www.autosmartcode.com/smartauction-scraper): Automate Ally SmartAuction listings, condition reports and buy-now pricing through your own dealer account. Off-lease inventory scored daily.
- [EDGE Pipeline Scraper](https://www.autosmartcode.com/edge-pipeline-scraper): Automate EDGE Pipeline and Simulcast run lists from the independent auctions you buy at. Every lane scored against your buy box in one overnight pass.
- [Private Dealer Marketplace & Auction Portal Scraping](https://www.autosmartcode.com/dealer-marketplace-scraper): Most dealers buy on a platform nobody has heard of. If you can log into it, it can be automated: run lists, pricing and condition data, scored daily.

## Salvage auctions

- [Copart Scraper](https://www.autosmartcode.com/copart-scraper): Copart scraper for rebuilders, exporters and parts buyers. Lot details, damage type, run-and-drive status, retail value and sale dates in one dataset.
- [IAA Auction Scraper](https://www.autosmartcode.com/iaa-scraper): Custom IAA scraper pulling every matching salvage and clean-title lot: damage, run-and-drive, ACV, title, odometer and sale date, in one daily sheet.

## Vehicle history reports by VIN

- [Carfax Report Automation — Bulk Vehicle History by VIN](https://www.autosmartcode.com/carfax-scraper): Run a whole VIN list through your own Carfax dealer account. Accidents, service records, owner count and title brands as spreadsheet columns, not PDFs.
- [AutoCheck Report Automation — Bulk VIN History Pulls](https://www.autosmartcode.com/autocheck-scraper): Pull AutoCheck reports for a whole run list through your own dealer account. Score, comparison range, title brands and announcements as columns, not PDFs.

## Marketplace, government and fleet sale monitoring

- [Facebook Marketplace Car Alerts for Dealers](https://www.autosmartcode.com/facebook-marketplace-car-scraper): Facebook Marketplace car alerts for dealers: private-party vehicles matching your buy box across the cities you choose, with price, mileage and photos.
- [eBay Motors Scraper](https://www.autosmartcode.com/ebay-motors-scraper): Custom eBay Motors scraper for dealers: live and sold vehicle listings, VIN, bids, Buy It Now price, mileage and seller, delivered daily as one clean sheet.
- [GovDeals Vehicle Scraper & Alerts](https://www.autosmartcode.com/govdeals-scraper): GovDeals vehicle alerts for dealers: city, county and state fleet cars and trucks matching your buy box, with mileage, location, current bid and closing time.
- [GSA Auctions Vehicle Scraper & Alerts](https://www.autosmartcode.com/gsa-auctions-scraper): GSA Auctions vehicle alerts for dealers: federal fleet cars, trucks and SUVs that match your buy box, with mileage, location, current bid and closing time.

## Retail listing and market pricing data

- [AutoTrader Scraper](https://www.autosmartcode.com/autotrader-scraper): Custom AutoTrader scraper pulling every matching listing daily: VIN, price, mileage, trim, dealer and photos in one clean spreadsheet.
- [Cars.com Scraper](https://www.autosmartcode.com/cars-com-scraper): Cars.com scraper capturing every matching listing: VIN, price, deal rating, mileage, dealer and photos, refreshed daily into Excel or Sheets.
- [CarGurus Scraper](https://www.autosmartcode.com/cargurus-scraper): CarGurus scraper capturing listings, instant market value, deal ratings, price history and dealer reputation across any US market.
- [CarMax Scraper](https://www.autosmartcode.com/carmax-scraper): CarMax scraper pulling live nationwide inventory: VIN, no-haggle price, mileage, trim, store location and transfer availability, refreshed daily.
- [AutoNation Inventory Scraper — Dealer Group Listing Data](https://www.autosmartcode.com/autonation-scraper): Track AutoNation inventory across every rooftop: VIN, price, mileage, trim, store and days listed, in one refreshed sheet. Works for any dealer group.
- [AutoScout24 Scraper](https://www.autosmartcode.com/autoscout24-scraper): AutoScout24 scraper for dealers and traders. Listings, prices, mileage and dealer details across Germany, Italy and every AutoScout24 market.
- [Carsales Scraper](https://www.autosmartcode.com/carsales-scraper): Carsales.com.au scraper for Australian dealers. Pull listings, prices, kilometres, dealer details and state-level market data into one dataset.
- [Otomoto Scraper](https://www.autosmartcode.com/otomoto-scraper): Custom Otomoto scraper pulling every matching Polish and Central European listing: price, mileage, VIN where shown, dealer and photos, in one sheet.

## Guides: MMR, valuation and vehicle history

- [What Is MMR? The Manheim Market Report Explained for Dealers](https://www.autosmartcode.com/blog/what-is-mmr-manheim-market-report): What MMR actually measures, why it moves, how far to trust it against a specific car, and where it quietly misleads you. Written for dealers who bid on it.
- [How to Automate Manheim MMR Price Checks (Without Breaking Your Account)](https://www.autosmartcode.com/blog/automate-manheim-mmr): Checking MMR one VIN at a time does not scale past a few dozen cars. How to pull Manheim Market Report values in bulk, safely, through your own dealer login.
- [How to Price Used Cars Against the Live Market, Not a Book Value](https://www.autosmartcode.com/blog/price-used-cars-market-data): Book values lag the market by weeks. How to price used cars against live wholesale and retail data instead, and what to do when the two disagree.
- [How Fuel Prices Move Used Vehicle Values — and How to Track It in MMR](https://www.autosmartcode.com/blog/fuel-prices-used-vehicle-values): Fuel prices move truck and hybrid values on a predictable lag. How the lag works, how big it gets, and how to track it in MMR before the repricing hits.
- [AutoCheck vs Carfax: Which Report to Trust, and How to Pull Both in Bulk](https://www.autosmartcode.com/blog/autocheck-vs-carfax-vehicle-history): The two reports disagree more often than dealers expect. Where each is strong, where each goes blind, and how to pull both per VIN without two tabs a car.
- [What Is an AutoCheck Report? The Score, the History, and How to Read One](https://www.autosmartcode.com/blog/what-is-an-autocheck-report): What the AutoCheck score means, how it is built, what it covers that Carfax does not, and the blind spots nobody mentions. How to read one properly.
- [Free VIN Decoding with NHTSA vPIC: What You Get, and What You Still Have to Buy](https://www.autosmartcode.com/blog/free-vin-decoder-nhtsa-api): NHTSA vPIC decodes any VIN free and unlimited. What it returns, what it will never tell you, and how to use it to cut your paid lookup bill on a run list.

## Guides: sourcing, dealer workflow and buying decisions

- [How Dealers Find Good Auction Cars Faster: Buy Box In, Ranked Watch List Out](https://www.autosmartcode.com/blog/find-good-auction-cars-faster): Five questions dealers ask — finding cars faster, checking Carfax and AutoCheck automatically, comparing against MMR before bidding, buy-box alerts, and watching several auctions at once — answered with the workflow that does it.
- [Stop Copying VINs: See MMR, Carfax and AutoCheck on the Auction Listing Itself](https://www.autosmartcode.com/blog/mmr-carfax-autocheck-on-listing-extension): The copy-VIN, open-tab, paste, come-back loop costs a buyer hours a week. How a custom browser extension reads the VIN off the page and shows MMR, history and your margin on the same screen.
- [Government and Off-Lease Car Auctions: Where Dealers Find Them and How to Watch Them Daily](https://www.autosmartcode.com/blog/government-off-lease-car-auctions-dealers): GSA Auctions, GovDeals, police and municipal sales, and the off-lease closed-sale chain — where the cars come from, what makes them good buys, and how to monitor them without checking ten sites a day.
- [How to Automate Your Used-Car Merchandising Workflow](https://www.autosmartcode.com/blog/automate-car-merchandising-workflow): From auction win to live listing: photos, descriptions, pricing and syndication. Which merchandising steps automate cleanly, and which still need a person.
- [What Auction and Dealer Data Automation Actually Costs in 2026](https://www.autosmartcode.com/blog/how-much-does-web-scraping-cost): Real prices for run-list triage, bulk history reports, custom VIN extensions and inventory feeds. What drives the number up, and what a fair quote looks like.
- [Is Scraping Auction and Vehicle Data Legal? What Dealers Need to Know](https://www.autosmartcode.com/blog/is-web-scraping-legal): Public data, logged-in auction portals, history reports and terms of service — where the lines actually fall for a dealer automating their own accounts.

## Guides: how auction data collection works

- [What Is Web Scraping? A Plain-English Guide for Car Dealers](https://www.autosmartcode.com/blog/what-is-web-scraping): No code, no jargon. What scraping is, how it turns an auction run list or a listings page into a spreadsheet, and what it can and cannot do for a dealership.
- [Why Your Auction Scraper Keeps Getting Blocked (And How to Fix It)](https://www.autosmartcode.com/blog/bypass-captcha-anti-bot-scraping): Rate limits, fingerprinting, session expiry and CAPTCHA walls are why overnight jobs die quietly. What actually causes blocks, and what fixes them.
- [Self-Healing Scrapers: What AI Fixes When an Auction Site Changes](https://www.autosmartcode.com/blog/self-healing-scrapers-ai): A renamed CSS class an LLM can recover from. A new login flow it cannot. An honest account of what self-healing scraping fixes, and what still wakes you up.
- [Using AI to Clean Messy Vehicle Data (And When Not To)](https://www.autosmartcode.com/blog/ai-parsing-scraped-data): Condition reports and free-text announcements parse well with an LLM. VINs, prices and mileage do not. Where AI earns its place, and where it costs you.
- [AutoScraper vs a Custom Build: What the Python Library Can and Cannot Do](https://www.autosmartcode.com/blog/autoscraper-python-library-vs-custom-scraper): AutoScraper learns patterns from an example and works on simple pages. Where it stops, logins, pagination, anti-bot, scheduling, and what you need instead.
